articles.title: John Baldessari on designing the newest BMW art car
articles.subtitle: Where art and automotive design collide
articles.excerpt: Apple Watch review: Design. For a slightly more opinionated version of the video review above, here's the male half of the team...
articles.author: admin

content.text: Conceptual artist John Baldessari brings his signature typographic style to BMW's long-running art car programme, the latest in a lineage stretching back decades.
The livery favours bold text fragments over abstract paint strokes — a departure from most entries in the series.
